## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with inline implementations for the µTest++ test runner.</p>


<p>This header provides the inline accessors of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">runner</span> class and the inline template implementation for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">runner::add_suite()</span>, the member function used to create and register a named test suite with a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">runner</span> instance, and for its deprecated alias <span class="doxyComputerOutput">runner::suite()</span>. It constructs a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">suite</span> object on the heap (wrapped in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::unique_ptr</span>) and transfers ownership to the runner via <span class="doxyComputerOutput">register_suite()</span>; the suite is run later, by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">run()</span>.</p>


<p>The implementation is separated into this inline header so that the template definition is visible at every call site without cluttering the main <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/runner-h">runner.h</a></span> declaration file.</p>


<p>This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>
